name: Love Stranded
source:
You wake up on an island, remembering nothing but your name... At least you're not alone – five strangers awaken beside you. But they might not be as friendly as they seem...

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
你在一座岛上醒来，除了你的名字什么都不记得……至少你并不孤单——五个陌生人在你身边醒来。但他们可能并不像看上去那么友好……

[来自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用程序[/url]]
